goal: Help users and GUIs track which master key corresponds to which physical device or cosigner
Allow assigning and querying friendly labels for keys in multisig setups
agreement: Unaddressed objection: labels should only be temporary in the GUI and not stored in the wallet (achow101)
Objection: ongoing maintenance costs for RPCs offer little benefit (rkrux)
Support for persisting key labels to help users identify signers at signing time (davidgumberg)
Concept and approach approval with testing (jeanpablojp, vicjuma, Eunovo)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because tracking device identities across cosigners is a UX convenience for multisig workflows
It is a deferrable feature enhancement rather than an essential wallet capability
